queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders
SELECT DISTINCT country FROM orders
SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM orders
SELECT DISTINCT segment FROM customer_segments
SELECT MIN(order_date), MAX(order_date) FROM orders
SELECT status, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status
SELECT count(*) FROM returns
SELECT oi.order_item_id, count(*) c FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id=oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id HAVING c>1 LIMIT 5

SELECT o.country,
       ROUND(SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qty_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur), 2) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_returned FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r
  ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY o.country
ORDER BY o.country

SELECT o.country,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur), 2) AS gross_revenue_eur
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY o.country
ORDER BY o.country

WITH order_net AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date,
         SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qty_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS net_value_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_returned FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r
    ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-03-31' THEN 'Q1_2025'
       WHEN order_date >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2024-12-31' THEN 'Q4_2024'
  END AS quarter,
  ROUND(AVG(net_value_eur), 2) AS avg_order_value_eur,
  COUNT(*) AS n_orders
FROM order_net
WHERE (order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-03-31')
   OR (order_date >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2024-12-31')
GROUP BY quarter

WITH order_gross AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date,
         SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS gross_value_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-03-31' THEN 'Q1_2025'
       WHEN order_date >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2024-12-31' THEN 'Q4_2024'
  END AS quarter,
  ROUND(AVG(gross_value_eur), 2) AS avg_order_value_eur,
  COUNT(*) AS n_orders
FROM order_gross
WHERE (order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-03-31')
   OR (order_date >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2024-12-31')
GROUP BY quarter
SELECT * FROM customer_segments LIMIT 5
SELECT count(*) FROM customer_segments WHERE valid_to IS NULL
SELECT customer_id, count(*) c FROM customer_segments GROUP BY customer_id HAVING c>1 LIMIT 5

WITH fr_q3 AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id,
         SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qty_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS net_value_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_returned FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r
    ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.country = 'France'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id
),
seg AS (
  SELECT f.order_id, f.net_value_eur,
         cs.segment
  FROM fr_q3 f
  LEFT JOIN customer_segments cs
    ON cs.customer_id = f.customer_id
    AND f.order_date >= cs.valid_from
    AND (cs.valid_to IS NULL OR f.order_date <= cs.valid_to)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN segment='VIP' THEN net_value_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS vip_net_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(net_value_eur), 2) AS total_net_revenue,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN segment='VIP' THEN net_value_eur ELSE 0 END) / SUM(net_value_eur), 2) AS vip_share_pct
FROM seg

WITH fr_q3 AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.country='France' AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
)
SELECT count(*) FROM fr_q3 f
LEFT JOIN customer_segments cs ON cs.customer_id=f.customer_id AND f.order_date>=cs.valid_from AND (cs.valid_to IS NULL OR f.order_date<=cs.valid_to)
WHERE cs.segment IS NULL

WITH fr_q3 AS (

         SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS gross_value_eur
  FROM orders o

  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.country = 'France'

  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN segment='VIP' THEN gross_value_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS vip_revenue,

  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN segment='VIP' THEN gross_value_eur ELSE 0 END) / SUM(gross_value_eur), 2) AS vip_share_pct
FROM seg

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur), 2) AS gross,
  ROUND(SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qty_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct/100.0) * o.fx_rate_to_eur), 2) AS net
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_returned FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.country='France' AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'

SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.quantity, r.qty_returned, oi.unit_price
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id
JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_returned FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id=oi.order_item_id
WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.country='France' AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
ORDER BY r.qty_returned DESC LIMIT 20
